_readme: Search/social metadata. Per-page entries are keyed by route; `ogImage` is a key from images.json -> og. Strings may use {brand}, {brandFull}, {shortName}, {siteUrl}, {year} and any key from `urls` in config.json (e.g. {discord}); they are filled in automatically. The `game` block also accepts {game}, {price} and {id}.
